note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: State the interval since surgery, because the expected appearance changes with it.
Report each component of the construct separately: the graft, the fixation, the tunnel, the osteotomy.
State what the metal prevented you from assessing.
Repeat the measurements that led to the operation wherever recurrence is the question.
- The report should state what the artefact prevented.
